Everyone is smiling and giggling in this segment. He would be embarrassed to show up with those investment losses. Never a pushback from moderators because the network wants panelists to look good and contributors are selling a service or gathering assets. Describes the universal Fin TV Equation: smile, sweep losers under the rug, talk confidently, deliver gut feels (not modelling), never memorialize recommendations and always look in the rear view mirror. Adopts Roy Cohn's 3 Rules of Winning. So disingenuous and contra to the investment well-being of their most important stakeholders - the viewers.
